Thanks for the intro — we are evaluating Redwood for a pilot in our clinical analytics team. Procurement asked me to send over the security questionnaires we use: SIG + CAIQ are the primary ones, and we also need to start a conversation about FedRAMP scoping and whether Redwood has a plan for ISO 27001 alignment (customer requirement).

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm turnaround time to complete SIG/CAIQ responses and provide SOC 2 evidence artifacts (Type II)?
- Do you have a mapping of Redwood controls to ISO 27001 clauses and evidence owners we can review? Also curious if you have a FedRAMP readiness estimate or high-level roadmap.

We'd like to target having completed questionnaires and evidence by Feb 12 to sync with our vendor review committee. I can share the Greenfield templates if that helps.

Hi Samira — great to hear from you and thanks for the timeline. We can meet the Feb 12 target with a coordinated plan. Proposed approach:

1) We will populate the SIG/CAIQ workbook with our standard responses and reference artifacts.
2) For SOC 2 Type II evidence we will provide a package of representative artifacts (policy excerpts, audit reports, configuration screenshots) and a signed attestation where available.
3) ISO 27001: we maintain a control mapping spreadsheet that maps our internal controls to ISO clauses; Neha (copied) owns that mapping and will confirm scope and outstanding evidence.
4) FedRAMP: we are not currently FedRAMP authorized; we do maintain a high-level readiness roadmap. We can share the roadmap and an estimated timeline for a high-assurance government review if you provide anticipated scoping (data residency, PII/PHI processing).

Can we set a 30-minute MAP (mutual action plan) call tomorrow or Monday to align owners and deadlines? I've attached two quick stubs for the intake: "SIG-request-checklist.pdf" and a starter "preliminary-evidence-index.csv" to show the artifacts we will pull. Please send your SIG/CAIQ workbook when ready.

Next steps from our side: Neha will validate the ISO map and produce a single consolidated evidence list; Dylan will coordinate commercial/contract questions and confirm if anything needs to be escalated to our security leadership.

Thanks — I will block time once you confirm availability.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
